brandComInfo.introduce:
艾利丹尼森公司（NYSE：AVY）是一家专门设计和制造各种标签和功能材料的全球性材料科学公司。 艾利丹尼森的产品几乎用于各行各业，其中包括用于标签和图形应用的压敏材料； 用于工业，医疗和零售应用的胶带和其他粘合解决方案； 服装的吊牌，标签和装饰； 服务于服装和其他市场的射频识别（RFID）解决方案。 公司总部位于美国俄亥俄州，在50多个国家/地区拥有35,000多名员工。 2023年的销售额为84亿美元。

       艾利丹尼森集团公司作为美国财富500强企业之一，2019年获得由世界最具影响力的商业杂志《福布斯》评选颁发的“2019年度全球最佳雇主”，同时在澳大利亚、中国、印度、日本、新加坡、马来西亚、泰国及越南等地获得“卓越职场”认证。

       艾利丹尼森中国连续7年获得亚洲权威第三方机构《亚洲人力资源》评选颁发的“亚洲最佳企业雇主”，“2023年度多元、平等和包容特别奖”及“2023年度数字化转型特别奖”，；国内专业人力资源服务商《前程无忧》评选颁发“2020-2022年度中国典范雇主”，2020-2023年度“中国大学生喜爱雇主”；国内DEI多元公平包容平台sHero评选颁发“2022年度多元公平包容最佳实践包容性大奖”。

jobInfo.postDescription:
ABOUT YOUR ROLE
You will be responsible for working & communicating with design teams to evaluate the functionality of new computer controlled electro-mechanical equipment for the labelling & garment retail industries.
Document your findings, highlight improvements that you believe will enhance the performance & user friendliness of the machinery or associated software.
Write documentation & user guides to be used by both Avery Dennison engineers & customers.

 YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE
Test & evaluate new hardware & software printing products. Provide constructive feedback to the design teams.
To work closely with design teams - both within Avery Dennison & 3rd part suppliers to test, diagnose issues, in order to enhance the performance of the equipment.
To fully evaluate new label printing solutions ahead of deployment to customers including electronic printers, label media including RFID & factory supply chain monitoring solutions.
Support & evaluate label printing or supply chain software & linked cloud based data processing systems.  Test, provide feedback on functionality & document the solution.
Write technical operating user guides to be used by customers & Avery Dennison teams.
Provide technical training to other engineers on new hardware/software products.
Provide remote technical support to both customers & Avery Dennison engineers via telephone or email.

 WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU
Degree or Higher Diploma college level education.
Communication & report writing in English essential.
Previous experience in a support role - software or technical support.
Candidates must be computer literate - knowledge of Microsoft or Google Office products.
Electro-mechanical background advantageous.
Knowledge or experience of RFID beneficial, but training will be provided.
Previous experience in the label printing or a manufacturing industry preferred.
Display & utilize logical & analytical problem solving skills - able to work independently.
Join a team that has members located in both Asia & Europe - be able to work as part of a team, share knowledge & experience to other team members, as well as to colleagues throughout this global company.
Be willing to travel locally & abroad if requested.

 AVERY DENNISON IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY PROVIDER. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or other protected status.
